family.description: This domain is found at the C-terminal of Type I restriction enzyme HindI endonuclease subunit (also known as R protein) from Haemophilus influenzae related sequences from bacteria and archaea [[cite:PUB00099965]]. This domain is typically between 255 to 340 amino acids in length and its function is unknown. This domain is found associated with [pfam:PF04851], [pfam:PF04313].
family.name: Type I restriction enzyme HindI endonuclease subunit-like, C-terminal
